policy.biome_scale: primary biome is stable across each region
policy.region_assignment: multi-source weighted flood growth / guaranteed connected masses
policy.transition_belts: sector edges touching another region become ecotones

policy.front_grouping: connected boundary edges sharing the same unordered channel pair
policy.front_rule: 4-neighbor boundary between non-neutral sectors with different alignments

policy.composition: preferred zones vary to suppress repeated corner placement
policy.spacing: regional anchors prefer >=2 sector Manhattan separation

policy.invariant: global corridor topology fixed first; local scene realizes it without changing sector order
policy.landmark_spurs: uncovered regional/world landmarks connect to macro network
policy.local_realization: actual world link anchors joined by walkable local scene routes
policy.regional_connectors: each region center connects to existing macro network
policy.world_spine: start sector to world landmark or opposite corner

policy.stacking: multiplicative local density modifiers; additive channel intensity
